body: To avoid later confusions we can rename the `helper` instances in [this file](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/57b3269c350bd7d46b2174003b0cd764eb848eaf/src/lib/voiceSearchHelper/__tests__/index-test.ts) to `voiceSearchHelper` (same with `getHelper` to `getVoiceSearchHelper`) because it exposes a `getState` method.
